statusDetail: Coverage-complete remote audit of four representative content templates plus search and failure states.

page.framework: hand-authored multipage site with client-rendered catalog data
page.notes: Public adult media catalog. Audited structure and behavior without attempting account or commercial flows.

artifacts.caption: Rendered home page at desktop viewport
Home under dark preference remains light
Compact trace timings and long tasks
Compact network totals and third-party signals
Selected Lighthouse category and audit results
Metadata, semantics, focus, responsive and platform probe
Main document and 404 HTTP response headers

checkOutcomes.method: Dark-mode screenshot plus computed color-scheme probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: The dark preference screenshot is visually identical to light mode, and computed colorScheme is normal.
The reduced-motion probe matched the requested preference and found zero active animations during the sampled state.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse contrast audit and CSS inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse failed color contrast, and rendered CSS supplied no first-party forced-colors or prefers-contrast adaptation.
CSS inspection found no view-transition usage; route changes and result navigation swap abruptly with no focus or directional cue.
DOM and CSS inspection found no first-party scroll-linked animation that uses a main-thread scroll handler.
The sampled pages use native scrolling and ordinary links; no custom pointer-driven gesture fought platform behavior.
The long listing retains static chrome and provides no scroll progress or scroll-state response; CSS has no scroll-state query.
No tooltip, popover, or floating menu was present on the representative paths, so there was no anchored overlay to position.
checkOutcomes.reason: No tooltip, popover, or floating menu was present on the representative paths, so there was no anchored overlay to position.

checkOutcomes.evidence: CSS inspection found no view-transition usage; route changes and result navigation swap abruptly with no focus or directional cue.

checkOutcomes.method: Load screenshots on desktop and mobile
checkOutcomes.evidence: Desktop and mobile load screenshots showed no overlay obscuring the catalog content at capture time.
No first-party modal, disclosure, or transient overlay was encountered on the representative paths.
checkOutcomes.reason: No first-party modal, disclosure, or transient overlay was encountered on the representative paths.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The first viewport reserves roughly 270px of blank advertising space before recently added content, while the load invokes 25 third-party origins.
At 360x800, layout reported scrollWidth 360, clientWidth 360, and zero horizontal overflow on home and listing templates.
CSS inspection found no @container rule; reused catalog cards adapt only through viewport media queries.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse target-size audit and focus probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse failed target-size, and the focus probe found multiple zero-size focusable anchors with no visible outline.
The first viewport identifies the catalog, exposes search and category navigation, and the listing cards link directly to details.

checkOutcomes.method: Programmatic search attempt and browse walkthrough
checkOutcomes.evidence: After setting the query to test and activating Search, the captured state remained the unchanged home listing rather than results or feedback.
An intentional missing URL returned a bare nginx 404 containing no site navigation, explanation, retry, or recovery link.
Lighthouse measured LCP 9.7s and Speed Index 5.6s; the independent trace measured LCP 2.78s, showing variable but often slow loading.
Layout measured CLS 0 on mobile and 0.013 on desktop; Lighthouse measured 0.004, all within the good range.
Trace measured 89 ms total blocking time and Lighthouse measured 110 ms TBT, with no sustained main-thread blockage.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR summary confirmed against DOM script attributes
checkOutcomes.evidence: HAR identified four VeryHigh parser-blocking styles and multiple High parser-inserted classic scripts; Lighthouse estimated 1.69s render-blocking savings and 470KiB cache savings.
Lighthouse estimated 77KiB unused JavaScript, while 24 scripts transferred 422,206 bytes and third parties accounted for 99 of 105 requests.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse accessibility audits plus DOM/image probes
checkOutcomes.evidence: The image audit found all 53 images lacked alt; Lighthouse also failed link-name and select-name, and the search input has no label.
Lighthouse color-contrast audit failed on the rendered home page.
The DOM has 25 h1 elements, no main landmark, no html lang, and Lighthouse reported a malformed accessibility tree.
Mobile screenshots show readable text that reflows in one column without clipping.

checkOutcomes.method: Mobile layout and Lighthouse target-size audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse failed target-size, and the focus probe found multiple zero-size focusable anchors with no visible outline.
Lighthouse errors-in-console audit passed with no recorded browser errors.
All 53 images lack explicit dimensions; Lighthouse found 16 deprecated API warnings and DevTools inspector issues.
All 53 images lack explicit dimensions; Lighthouse found 16 deprecated API warnings and DevTools inspector issues.
DOM inspection found title Hitomi.la and a non-empty meta description.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM, robots.txt, sitemap, and discoverability probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: The page has viewport metadata, robots allows crawling, the sitemap is reachable, and 317 anchors were found with only one lacking href.

checkOutcomes.method: Images primitive, HAR, and Lighthouse image audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 338KiB image delivery savings, and the image audit found 53 images without dimensions and three legacy-format assets.
Third-party code accounts for 99 of 105 requests and 690,071 of 698,326 transferred bytes, including large push and ad scripts unrelated to core browsing.

checkOutcomes.reason: No developer intent for an agent-facing capability is declared, and the sampled site offers only public browsing rather than an agent action surface.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The catalog has no user-facing summarisation or language-model workflow that would justify on-device inference.
checkOutcomes.reason: The catalog has no user-facing summarisation or language-model workflow that would justify on-device inference.

checkOutcomes.evidence: After ten top-to-bottom scroll cycles, heap self size changed from 25,413,270 to 25,544,564 bytes, about 0.5 percent, with object and closure counts stable or lower.

checkOutcomes.method: Heap summary and Lighthouse DOM diagnostics
checkOutcomes.evidence: The initial heap contains 142,956 nodes and 25.4MiB self size for a simple listing, dominated by 22.4MiB native allocations from the ad-heavy page.
Baseline and post-scroll heap summaries showed stable object and closure counts and no Detached constructor among the reported leading constructors.

principleOutcomes.reason: Both emerging agent-readiness checks were judged out of scope because the site declares no agent-facing or on-device inference intent.

paths.description: Home and recently-added listing, representing entry navigation, search, content cards, preferences, responsive layout, performance, security, and memory.
Alphabetic tags index, representing dense taxonomy and long-list navigation.
English-language listing, representing localized catalog listing and long-page mobile layout.
One current content detail page reached from the home listing, representing the primary browse-to-detail journey and entity metadata.
Search activation from the home input, representing the primary query flow.
Intentional unknown route, representing HTTP/network failure recovery.

findings.summary: Dark mode is not supported
findings.suggestedFix: Add color-scheme and preference-driven light/dark surface tokens.
findings.evidence: The dark preference screenshot is visually identical to light mode, and computed colorScheme is normal.

findings.summary: Contrast preferences and minimum contrast are not reliably supported
findings.suggestedFix: Correct failing color pairs and add forced-colors/prefers-contrast adaptations for essential controls.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed color contrast, and rendered CSS supplied no first-party forced-colors or prefers-contrast adaptation.

findings.summary: Navigation changes lack transition and attention cues
findings.suggestedFix: Use progressive View Transitions and move focus to the new page heading after navigation.
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found no view-transition usage; route changes and result navigation swap abruptly with no focus or directional cue.

findings.summary: Long pages provide no position-aware navigation
findings.suggestedFix: Add a lightweight scroll progress or back-to-top affordance for very long listing pages.
findings.evidence: The long listing retains static chrome and provides no scroll progress or scroll-state response; CSS has no scroll-state query.

findings.summary: Advertising space displaces the core catalog
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the large blank ad slot from the first viewport and defer nonessential advertising until after core content.
findings.evidence: The first viewport reserves roughly 270px of blank advertising space before recently added content, while the load invokes 25 third-party origins.

findings.summary: Reusable cards are not container responsive
findings.suggestedFix: Give card containers container-type and adapt card internals with @container where reused.
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found no @container rule; reused catalog cards adapt only through viewport media queries.

findings.summary: Touch and keyboard targets are not consistently operable
findings.suggestedFix: Increase small target size/spacing, remove hidden focusable links, and preserve a clear :focus-visible ring.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed target-size, and the focus probe found multiple zero-size focusable anchors with no visible outline.

findings.summary: Search activation gives no visible result or error
findings.suggestedFix: Make Search submit deterministically and expose a loading, result, empty, or error state with focus management.
findings.evidence: After setting the query to test and activating Search, the captured state remained the unchanged home listing rather than results or feedback.

findings.summary: The 404 state is a dead end
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a branded 404 with explanation, search, home link, and retry/navigation options.
findings.evidence: An intentional missing URL returned a bare nginx 404 containing no site navigation, explanation, retry, or recovery link.

findings.summary: Largest content paint is slow and variable
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP content, remove early ad contention, and retest under representative mobile conditions.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 9.7s and Speed Index 5.6s; the independent trace measured LCP 2.78s, showing variable but often slow loading.

findings.summary: Parser-blocking resources and cache gaps delay content
findings.suggestedFix: Defer noncritical classic scripts, inline or consolidate critical CSS, and apply durable caching to static assets.
findings.evidence: HAR identified four VeryHigh parser-blocking styles and multiple High parser-inserted classic scripts; Lighthouse estimated 1.69s render-blocking savings and 470KiB cache savings.

findings.summary: Unused and third-party JavaScript dominate delivery
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unused scripts and load advertising or push dependencies only after explicit need or consent.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 77KiB unused JavaScript, while 24 scripts transferred 422,206 bytes and third parties accounted for 99 of 105 requests.

findings.summary: Images and controls lack accessible names
findings.suggestedFix: Add meaningful alt text, label the search field and selects, and ensure image links have discernible names.
findings.evidence: The image audit found all 53 images lacked alt; Lighthouse also failed link-name and select-name, and the search input has no label.

findings.summary: Rendered text and controls fail contrast
findings.suggestedFix: Replace failing foreground/background pairs with WCAG-compliant design tokens.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse color-contrast audit failed on the rendered home page.

findings.summary: Heading, landmark, language, and focus structure is malformed
findings.suggestedFix: Use one page h1, logical descendant headings, a main landmark, html lang, and remove hidden links from tab order.
findings.evidence: The DOM has 25 h1 elements, no main landmark, no html lang, and Lighthouse reported a malformed accessibility tree.

findings.summary: Assets and browser APIs show hygiene problems
findings.suggestedFix: Add intrinsic image dimensions, replace deprecated APIs, and resolve DevTools inspector issues.
findings.evidence: All 53 images lack explicit dimensions; Lighthouse found 16 deprecated API warnings and DevTools inspector issues.

findings.summary: Canonical, entity, and share metadata are absent
findings.suggestedFix: Add canonical URLs, accurate Open Graph metadata, and applicable schema.org JSON-LD to detail pages.
findings.evidence: DOM probes found no canonical, Open Graph tags, or JSON-LD on home; the detail template likewise lacks structured/share metadata.

findings.summary: Response headers and cookies lack basic browser defenses
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy; mark all cookies Secure with appropriate SameSite.
findings.evidence: HTTPS is used, but CSP, HSTS, nosniff, clickjacking protection, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy are all absent; two cookies lack Secure.

findings.summary: The page exposes users to an excessive third-party tracking surface
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unnecessary trackers and push SDKs, gate optional third parties behind consent, and proxy or self-host essential assets where appropriate.
findings.evidence: The load contacted 25 third-party origins, made 99 third-party requests, transferred 690,071 third-party bytes, and included an identified ad tracker.

findings.summary: Core catalog content disappears without JavaScript
findings.suggestedFix: Render listing titles, links, and core metadata in server HTML, then enhance sorting and previews with JavaScript.
findings.evidence: Only 5 percent of rendered content words exist in raw HTML; the no-JS crawler view loses the listing content.

findings.summary: Language-aware routes lack language and bidi foundations
findings.suggestedFix: Set accurate lang and dir per route and replace physical direction CSS with logical properties.
findings.evidence: html has neither lang nor dir, despite numerous language-specific routes, and the CSS probe found no logical properties.

findings.summary: Image delivery remains wasteful despite modern formats
findings.suggestedFix: Provide intrinsic dimensions and correctly sized responsive AVIF/WebP sources; eliminate avoidable legacy assets.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 338KiB image delivery savings, and the image audit found 53 images without dimensions and three legacy-format assets.

findings.summary: Advertising and push dependencies consume nearly the entire page budget
findings.suggestedFix: Set a strict third-party budget, remove low-value ad/push dependencies, and defer remaining work until after core content.
findings.evidence: Third-party code accounts for 99 of 105 requests and 690,071 of 698,326 transferred bytes, including large push and ad scripts unrelated to core browsing.

findings.summary: Initial memory footprint is disproportionate to the listing UI
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce third-party scripts and injected ad DOM, then enforce heap and node-count budgets in repeated measurements.
findings.evidence: The initial heap contains 142,956 nodes and 25.4MiB self size for a simple listing, dominated by 22.4MiB native allocations from the ad-heavy page.
